<document id="OB-23-11" title="Operations Bulletin 23-11: Hot Line Hold Tag Change" family="bulletin">
<passage n="00" section="Control box">
SGW  DISTRIBUTION OPERATIONS

OB-23-11
OPERATIONS BULLETIN 23-11: HOT LINE HOLD TAG CHANGE

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Document: OB-23-11                                                                           |
| Effective: 2023-11-13                                                                        |
| Owner: Distribution Operations                                                               |
| Subject Matter Expert: Pettigrew, Anselm K.                                                  |
| Periodic review due: 2024-11-30                                                              |
| Classification: SGW Internal - Controlled                                                    |
| Approved: Manager, Transmission Operations, Pettigrew, Anselm K., 2023-11-06                 |
| Approved: Director, Distribution Operations, Thibodeaux, Marcus R., 2023-11-08               |
| Applies to: SC, GA systems                                                                   |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
</passage>
<passage n="01" section="1. PURPOSE; 2. CHANGE">
1. PURPOSE

Replace the Hot Line Hold (HLH) tag used on SGW transmission and distribution devices.

2. CHANGE

2.1 From 2023-11-13 the HLH tag is red with a white border, stock HLH-23R.

2.2 The tag has fields for the switching order number (SWO), the clearance holder's name and
    phone, and the date and time placed.

2.3 The old yellow tag (stock HLH-17Y) shall be removed from stores by 2023-12-01.

2.4 Old tags already hanging stay valid until the clearance is released. Do not swap tags on a
    held device.
</passage>
<passage n="02" section="3. RULES UNCHANGED; 4. ACTIONS">
3. RULES UNCHANGED

A Hot Line Hold sets the device to non-reclose. Only the clearance holder releases it.
Three-part communication applies to every placement and release (TSO 06.110).

4. ACTIONS

+---------------------------------+----------------------------------+-------------------------+
| Action                          | Position                         | Due                     |
+=================================+==================================+=========================+
| Collect and destroy yellow tag  | Supervisor, Material Stores      | 2023-12-01              |
| stock                           |                                  |                         |
| Brief line and substation crews | Line supervisors                 | 2023-12-15              |
| Add new tag to mutual-aid       | Director, Distribution           | 2023-12-15 (DOM 12.040) |
| safety briefing                 | Operations                       |                         |
| Revise tag description in TSO   | Manager, Transmission Operations | next revision           |
| 06.110 at next revision         |                                  |                         |
+---------------------------------+----------------------------------+-------------------------+

This bulletin has no expiry date. It stays in force until incorporated into TSO 06.110.

Contact: Transmission Control Center 803-641-4400, 24 h.
</passage>
</document>
